title: Program wire — invocation (§8.3)
description: What reaches a handler, and under what identity. The key's PRESENCE is structural and lives here; everything that makes it mean anything — the (host, session, endpoint) scope, at-most-once admission, and the fact that exactly-once is forgone — is §8 and cannot be schematised.

endpoint.description: The entry point named — the one string that always comes off the wire, and therefore the one a diagnostic may never echo (§6.5).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Present-and-empty is a different claim from absent and is refused on its own class (§8.3).
